groups.title: Beat 4 · trip a breaker on camera

beats.cue: “A stub adapter that always throws, wrapped with failureThreshold 3. Three failed streams and the state goes open — from here calls fail fast with no network touched, and the cascade falls through to the next candidate.”
beats.script: A stub adapter that always throws, wrapped with failureThreshold 3. Three failed streams and the state goes open — from here calls fail fast with no network touched, and the cascade falls through to the next candidate. [[pause:1.5s]] This command is replayable offline, so its result is part of the repository's machine-checked demo contract. State: open · stats {state:open, consecutiveFailures:0, transitions:1, lastTrippedAt:…} — the real @crewhaus/circuit-breaker out of the bundle --check installed, no credentials involved.
beats.command: bun --cwd live/dist -e 'import { wrap } from "@crewhaus/circuit-breaker"; const stub = { providerId: "anthropic", features: {}, estimateTokens: () => 1, async *stream() { throw new Error("simulated upstream 503"); } }; const b = wrap(stub, { adapterName: "claude-sonnet-5", failureThreshold: 3 }); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { try { for await (const _ of b.stream({ model: "x", system: [], messages: [], maxTokens: 8 })) {} } catch {} } console.log("claude-sonnet-5 after 3 failures → state:", b.state(), "| stats:", JSON.stringify(b.stats()))'
